profile: An engineer who learned to love the funnel. Product manager and hands-on AI builder with experience across consumer subscriptions, international D2C and backend engineering. Combines discovery, experimentation and commercial judgement with the ability to design and ship working products, from assisted-sales journeys at Times Internet to independent AI and consumer tools.

roles.title: Independent Product Builder | AI & Consumer Products
roles.sub: Built AI agents, marketing platforms and family-care products from concept to working software.
bullets: Parwah: Own product discovery, UX and engineering for a live family-care website. Built shared care coordination and parent-controlled permissions so relatives can organise support across cities while parents control access.

Lifecycle OS: Built a brand-agnostic D2C marketing platform with 16 modules and a 90-day campaign-planning workflow, bringing analysis, campaign preparation and creative generation into one workspace.
The Third Eye: Built a personal AI assistant combining retrieval-based memory, tool use, voice and task workflows, connecting conversational context with actions in a single interface.
Mailer Architect: Built a multi-model email workflow that turns briefs into brand-aligned HTML campaigns, with catalogue-aware product selection and provider fallbacks for campaign production.

roles.title: VAHDAM India | AGM, Product Management & D2C Growth
roles.sub: US, UK and global D2C markets
bullets: Worked on international purchase journeys, conversion funnels and lifecycle CRM, translating customer friction into product and campaign experiments.

Brought analytics, segmentation, campaign planning and email production into a connected retention workflow; ran Klaviyo and WebEngage experiments that contributed to UK marketing revenue growth within the first two months.

roles.title: Times Internet | Senior Product Manager
roles.sub: Progressed through Associate Product Manager and Product Manager roles
bullets: Grew ET Prime assisted-sales revenue from ₹15 lakh to ₹80 lakh per month in four months through lead-journey improvements, sales-call flows and A/B experimentation; the programme delivered 400%+ ROI in six months.

Led the ET Markets web and mobile-web redesign, delivering 27% higher engagement and ₹3 crore+ incremental annual revenue. App improvements contributed to 25% higher DAU, 15% longer sessions and 19% more screen views.
Built assisted-buying journeys that increased qualified leads from approximately 30 to 150+ per day; onboarding and engagement experiments improved subscriber retention by 10%.
Built AI TeleSuite for call transcription, conversation scoring and pitch guidance, giving sales teams a structured way to review calls and improve coaching.

Launched Times Health+ paid-subscription journeys and helped deliver registration and acquisition for the inaugural Times Internet Delhi Half Marathon, with 15,000+ participants. Received the ET Prime Team Award (2025) as part of the team.
